project.title: The impact of microplastics on wastewater-originated bacteria
project.description: The main purpose of this study was to investigate the impact of various microplastic types on bacterial community and AMR gene abundance in both Norwegian and South African WWTPs. The study also further investigated the effect of two artificial plastic aging treatments on these bacterial communities.
